shortDescription: Shares of Comcast Corporation NASDAQ:CMCSA slipped about 2.2% in the premarket trading on Friday after KeyBanC Capital Markets downgraded the stock to underweight and cut its price target to $18, citing worsening broadband subscriber trends, pressure on cable profitability, and weaker theme-park at…

children: slipped about 2.2% in the premarket trading on Friday after KeyBanC Capital Markets downgraded the stock to underweight and cut its price target to $18, citing worsening broadband subscriber trends, pressure on cable profitability, and weaker theme-park attendance.
Current PT implies a downside of about 19% from the stock's last close.

with "two options": refrain from matching promotions and risk more churn, or match them and pressure average revenue per user.
Nispel said the company’s cable and connectivity EBITDA was also unlikely to improve as much as expected, noting Comcast
has described 2026 as a year of investment and is undertaking the “largest cost transformation in the company history.”

Theme parks remain another drag. The analyst said universal attendance weakened through August, with total attendance down 3% year-on-year and Epic Universe’s average daily attendance falling to about 13,000 from 16,000 in July.
Nispel also said it did not view Comcast’s
NBCUniversal spin-off as a catalyst, citing deteriorating fundamentals and the loss of share-repurchase support.
